_readme: Registered recipe tools with no entry in DOMAIN_BY_TOOL (#1311).
A RATCHET, not an approval list. Every id here is a known gap: with no
domain the tool classifies as other:irreversible, which requires the top
trust level and cannot be unlocked by a standing permission — so it is
gated behind human approval even when it is a read.
The list may only SHRINK. To fix one: give it a domain in
src/workers/actionClass.ts and delete its line here. Do not add entries.
Suggested order (see #1311): reads first, driven by the registry's own
isWrite flag rather than by guessing from names; then writes by namespace,
each needing a real reversibility judgement. Loosening is the dangerous
direction, so writes deserve per-tool review rather than a sweep.
2026-08-10 batch 1 (#1311): 144 entries cleared — every connector tool declaring isWrite:false, plus two camelCase aliases that were governed differently from the identical canonical tool.
Remaining 42 are declared WRITES. Each needs a real judgement about whether it can be undone; loosening is the dangerous direction, so these get per-tool review, not a sweep.

2026-08-10 batch 2 (#1311): 8 irreversible writes given a real domain (messaging, db-write). Reversibility unchanged — this batch loosens nothing; it only stops them sharing one undifferentiated bucket.
